title: Experiment Kit — Frequentist + CUPED + Sequential + Bayesian A/B Testing

modules.dataset: Experiment ETL with pre-period covariate generation for CUPED. Synthetic A/B/C variant logs with configurable true lift, covariate correlation, and conversion rate. User-level assignment tracking.
modules.model: Four statistical engines: (1) Frequentist (Welch t-test, Chi-Square, Mann-Whitney U); (2) CUPED (covariate regression variance reduction: θ=Cov(Y,X)/Var(X)); (3) Sequential (mSPRT with O'Brien-Fleming alpha-spending for peeking protection); (4) Bayesian (Beta-Binomial conjugate updating with Monte Carlo P(superiority) + ROPE).
modules.tests: 13 tests: CUPED variance reduction (σ²_adj < σ²_raw), CUPED θ sign, CUPED preserves mean, mSPRT no false positive under null, mSPRT conservative boundary, Bayesian posterior means match data, P(superiority) → 1.0 for large effect, Beta-Binomial conjugate correctness, Welch p-value ∈ [0,1] + detects large effect, Chi-Square p-value range, ExperimentKit run_all, CLI smoke.
